Meta.title: Northkit - Self-owned Next.js starter
Meta.description: Open-source Next.js starter with Better Auth, Drizzle, native i18n, three themes and built-in SEO. No vendor lock-in.

Home.title: Ship your SaaS on a stack you own.
Home.subtitle: Next.js, Better Auth, Drizzle and native i18n. No Clerk, no lock-in, dark and mobile-first from day one.
Home.f1d: English and Indonesian out of the box, RTL-ready, hreflang handled.
Home.f2d: Better Auth with email, GitHub and Google. Your users stay in your database.
Home.f3d: User list, roles and ban controls already wired up.
Home.f4d: Midnight, Paper and Ember. Switch with one token file.
Home.f5d: Metadata, sitemap, robots, Open Graph and JSON-LD from the start.
Home.f6d: Docker, Vercel and Cloudflare guides, tested.
